title: CWP/8037/2025 of AMRIT BHUSHAN Vs THE PUNJAB STATE POWOER CORPORATION LTD AND ORS
respondents: The Punjab State Powoer Corporation Ltd And Ors
judge: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DEEPINDER SINGH NALWA
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB & HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 114 Date of Decision: 24.03.2025 Amrit Bhushan ..... Petitioner Versus The Punjab State Power Corporation Ltd. and others ..... Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DEEPINDER SINGH NALWA Present: Mr. Sushil Saini, Advocate for the petitioner. DEEPINDER SINGH NALWA, J (ORAL)

1. In the present petition, the petitioner has challenged the action of the respondents, whereby, the pay of the petitioner has been reduced w.e.f. the month of August 2023.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner, on instructions from the petitioner, submits that he will be satisfied if a direction is given to respondent No.2 to decide the legal notice dated 30.09.2024 (Annexure P-8) in a time bound manner.

3. Notice of motion.

4. At this stage, Mr. Sahil Sabhlok, Advocate, appears and accepts notice on behalf of the respondents and he does not oppose the prayer made by learned counsel for the petitioner. Chandigarh

5. In the light of above statement made by learned counsel for the petitioner, the present petition is disposed of with a direction to respondent No.2 to decide the legal notice dated 30.09.2024 (Annexure P-8), within a period of 02 months, from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order, in accordance with law. (DEEPINDER SINGH NALWA) 24.03.2025 JUDGE D.Bansal Chandigarh
